reserveReview.rationale: Exhibit B records $111,173,415 cash, $2,408,763,000 Treasury-collateralized reverse repos and $373,999,462 Treasury bills, totaling $2,893,935,877 at August 31, 2026, 5:00 PM Eastern Time. Independently reproduced amount / total * 100 yields 3.841599113635%, 83.234843561808% and 12.923557324556%; ordinary two-decimal rounding gives 3.84%, 83.23% and 12.92% (99.99%, with no residual assigned). D01 admits this complete dated report arithmetic at high confidence. No government money-market funds were held. All repos mature September 1, one day after the observation; the latest Treasury bill maturity is October 1, 31 days after period end. The October 3 metadata review admits maximum maturity of one day for the explicitly overnight repo category, and a conservative 93-day ceiling for the report's statement that Paxos only holds Treasury bills three months or less from maturity; the latter is a category restriction, not the observed portfolio maximum or WAM. Composition weights and as-of date are unchanged. Individual counterparties remain anonymized; existing risk categories and liquidity horizons are unchanged.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The KPMG-examined report establishes segregated, unencumbered redemption assets held on behalf of PYUSD token holders by Paxos Trust Company, N.A., an OCC-supervised national trust bank, and prohibits selling or repledging the securities collateralizing the repo agreements. The Paxos USD Stablecoin Terms (last modified June 30, 2026, section 3.2.3.1) state that assets held with Paxos Trust are held bankruptcy remote and would not be used to satisfy Paxos Trust debts in insolvency; that fiduciary custody structure supports the structured bankruptcy-remoteness grade. Individual banks, the qualified custodian, and repo counterparties are not named, per-account placement is not published, and rehypothecation terms for cash deposits are not established, so the mixed cash and repo envelope stays conditional.
